北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京大雨降温，风力大。记得添衣带伞，注意安全哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing: Heavy rain, strong wind. Dress warm, bring an umbrella, stay safe!
北京.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降14℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 5级

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪小雨，湿度高。出门备伞，享受湿润空气，别着凉！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi: Light rain, high humidity. Take an umbrella, enjoy the air, avoid colds!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，气温适宜。轻装出行，感受微风，保持好心情！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai: Overcast, mild. Dress light, enjoy the breeze, keep a good mood!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天闷热，湿度大。多补充水分，注意防暑，保持清爽。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou: Overcast, humid. Stay hydrated, prevent heatstroke, keep cool!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阵雨湿热。带好雨具，注意防暑降温，保持身体舒适。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen: Showers, hot, humid. Carry an umbrella, stay cool and comfortable!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，湿度偏高。记得带伞，保持心情舒畅，享受此刻。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou: Overcast, humid. Umbrella handy, stay cheerful, enjoy the moment!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，气温舒适。微风拂面，适合外出，多休息哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing: Overcast, comfortable. Gentle breeze, good for going out. Get rest!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天炎热，体感高。多喝水，注意防晒，保持活力满满。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu: Overcast, hot. Stay hydrated, sun protection, keep energized!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雾，能见度低，湿度百分百！出行注意安全，慢行。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan: Heavy fog, low visibility, 100% humidity! Drive safe, slow down.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗炎热，阳光强烈。注意防晒补水，小心中暑哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an: Sunny, hot. Sun protection, hydrate, watch out for heatstroke!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，气温适中。注意防晒，保持愉快心情，出门走走。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing: Cloudy, warm. Sun protection, keep happy, go for a walk!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阴天微凉，体感偏低。记得添衣，感受初秋凉意哦。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin: Overcast, cool. Add layers, feel the early autumn chill!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳小雨风大，体感凉。带好雨具，注意保暖，别着凉。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang: Light rain, strong wind, cool. Umbrella, stay warm, don't catch a cold!
沈阳.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，气温舒适。微风和煦，适合户外，放松身心。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming: Overcast, comfortable. Gentle breeze, good for outdoors, relax!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天微热，湿度大。保持清爽，带伞以防阵雨，心情美美哒。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen: Overcast, warm, humid. Stay cool, umbrella for showers, happy mood!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾，能见度低，体感凉爽。出行注意安全，保持好心情。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao: Foggy, low visibility, cool. Drive safe, keep a good mood!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有雾，气温偏低，湿度高。出行注意安全，多穿件衣服。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian: Foggy, cool, humid. Drive safe, dress warmer!
